messages.subject: Tempest completion accounts — quick one
messages.plaintextBody:
James — separate to Quartz: on Project Tempest (the Crestview deal), Castle & Vane have come back on the completion accounts and want to dispute the working capital peg again. Can you pick that up with Daniel Reeve tomorrow? I don't want it bleeding into the Quartz timetable. Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
